sloka: जात कौतूहलात् तत्र विमानस्थाः च देवताः ।ददृशुर् वाहिनीम् तेषाम् राक्षसानाम् गत आयुषाम् ॥३-२३-३०॥
transliteration: jāta kautūhalāt tatra vimānasthāḥ ca devatāḥ ।dadṛśur vāhinīm teṣām rākṣasānām gata āyuṣām ॥3-23-30॥

translations.english: The great ascetics were talking thus and more. The gods waiting eagerly on heavenly chariots saw the army of the demons whose life span was shortened (who were doomed to death).
